build_dataFrame_from_interchange: build a pandas DataFrame from any object supporting the DataFrame interchange protocol
convert_primitive_column_to_ndarray: convert a primitive column (int, uint, float, bool) from interchange protocol to a NumPy array
convert_categorical_column_to_series: convert a categorical column from interchange protocol to a pandas Categorical Series
convert_string_column_to_ndarray: convert a string column from interchange protocol to a pandas Series of strings
convert_datetime_column_to_ndarray: convert a datetime column from interchange protocol to a pandas datetime Series
